subject: NextShift onboarding — PO routing, DPA redline, SOC 2 link
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <s.lee@nextshiftlogistics.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com; ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: procure@nextshiftlogistics.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: security docs and PO setup for NextShift

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. We're ready to start procurement and need the following to get vendor activation across our systems:

- Fully executed DPA (we may need to propose a few redlines)
- SOC 2 report or read-only link to current report
- Current subprocessor roster (names + data centers/regions)
- PO routing instructions and the DocuSign flow for signatures

I've attached our PO template and the procurement checklist for reference (NextShift_PO_Instructions.pdf). Two initial questions: who on your side handles legal review and can you confirm Redwood's standard retention window for logs/audit data?

If possible, we'd like to run the DPA review this week so finance can start the PO.

Thanks —
Samantha Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
NextShift Logistics
procure@nextshiftlogistics.com

--- attachment: NextShift_PO_Instructions.pdf (application/pdf) ---

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <s.lee@nextshiftlogistics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: security docs and PO setup for NextShift

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the checklist and the PO template. Quick answers up front:
- Legal reviews DPAs; I've looped in Laura Bennett (Legal Ops) on this thread.
- Redwood retains audit logs for 13 months by default; we can discuss alternative retention windows in the DPA redline.

I've attached the current Redwood DPA (Redwood-DPA-v2.pdf) and our subprocessors roster (subprocessors-2026-09.csv). Our SOC 2 Type II report is available at the link below — we typically provide a read-only hosted copy for vendor diligence.

Links / attachments:
- SOC 2 report (read-only): https://redwood-drive.company/Shared/SOC2-2026-report.html
- Atts: Redwood-DPA-v2.pdf, subprocessors-2026-09.csv

Next steps I propose:
1) Laura will scan the DPA for anything material to NextShift and flag any redlines.
2) If you have specific data residency or retention constraints, send them over and we'll produce a short addendum.
3) Once DPA language is agreed, I'll route the PO via DocuSign to the contact on your PO template.

Ben — can you confirm expected SLA lane for onboarding and whether we should provide an expedited PO path?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
--- attachments: Redwood-DPA-v2.pdf (application/pdf), subprocessors-2026-09.csv (text/csv) ---

From: Samantha Lee <s.lee@nextshiftlogistics.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: procure@nextshiftlogistics.com
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: security docs and PO setup for NextShift

Thanks Jordan — received the docs. A couple follow-ups after an internal review:

1) Subprocessor granularity: can you expand the csv to include hosting region (us-east-1 / eu-west-1) and whether the subprocessor has access to customer unencrypted data? Our security team needs that detail to complete their risk assessment.

2) DPA redlines: our legal team will propose edits to Sections 4 (data retention) and 7 (subprocessor onboarding). We will send a marked-up PDF by EOD Thursday.

3) PO flow: is DocuSign the canonical path? Can Redwood accept a signed PO via our vendor portal as an alternative?

We'd like to close onboarding by Friday if possible — finance is prepared to issue the PO on receipt of an agreed DPA.

Thanks —
Samantha

--- attachment: NextShift_PO_Instructions.pdf (application/pdf) ---

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <s.lee@nextshiftlogistics.com>, procure@nextshiftlogistics.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: security docs and PO setup for NextShift

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the note and for flagging the redline items. Some quick clarifications and what we'll deliver today:

- Subprocessors: we'll augment the CSV with hosting region and an access flag (Y/N) for unencrypted customer data. You should get an updated file from Laura within the hour.
- DPA redline: Laura will accept your marked-up PDF and produce a response with accepted/declined edits. If there are only retention and subprocessor clarifications, we expect to have a final DPA back to you within 24 hours.
- DocuSign: yes, DocuSign is our canonical signature path for PO + DPA; however, we can accept a scanned PO through your vendor portal as a backup.

DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/123abc456def
HubSpot record: HS-4321

Next steps for both teams:
- NextShift: send marked DPA (we've agreed EOD Thu).
- Redwood: update subprocessors.csv + legal response; route DocuSign envelope once DPA is agreed.

If you'd like, we can schedule a brief stand-up Thursday morning to resolve any redline points quickly.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Head of Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198
